name: news-hoster
description: RSS news aggregation platform: NestJS API + React admin + shared SDK for the public websites.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/sdk && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm run test:e2e -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/admin && npm run typecheck -w packages/sdk
